note: Svantnerova tram stop, SW platform, looking NW along it. Pinhole camera: 2.04 m above the platform, horizon y 400, f ~1250 px, turned 4.6 deg left so the platform axis vanishes at x ~1060. Scale s(y) = (y - 400) / 615. The platform (X -3.6..1.6 m) runs from the bottom to the vanishing point: the long brown steel-tube shelter (solid back wall X -3.4, front tubes X -1.8, Z 6-20) with the bench inside at the left, the stop post with clock, stop plate and timetable case at the shelter's near front corner (Z 6.1), the light edge strip and the track at the right with the T3 standing at the platform (front at Z 10.5). The road (west carriageway) lies below the platform's left edge; the near-left ramp leads down to the zebra crossing towards the school.
